title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 12: Rehoboam forsakes the law, Shishak of Egypt attacks Jerusalem, and the king humbles himself.

questions.text: What did Rehoboam do once his kingdom was established and he was strong?
questions.explanation: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned Yahweh's law, and all Israel with him.

answers.text: He gave his gold to the poor

questions.text: In which year of King Rehoboam did Shishak king of Egypt come up against Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem.

questions.text: Which peoples came with Shishak out of Egypt?
questions.explanation: The people who came with him out of Egypt were the Lubim, the Sukkiim and the Ethiopians.

answers.text: The Moabites, the Ammonites and the Edomites
The Lubim, the Sukkiim and the Ethiopians

questions.text: What did the princes of Israel and the king say when they humbled themselves?
questions.explanation: They humbled themselves and said, "Yahweh is righteous."

answers.text: "We will serve the king of Egypt forever."

questions.text: Why did Yahweh say the people would become Shishak's servants?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said they would be his servants, that they may know his service and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.

answers.text: So that Egypt would grow rich from their gold
Because Shishak had prayed to Yahweh for it
To know God's service and the service of the kingdoms
So that they could learn the wisdom of Egypt

questions.text: What did King Rehoboam make in place of the shields of gold that Shishak took away?
questions.explanation: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place and committed them to the captains of the guard.

questions.text: How many years did Rehoboam reign in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem.

questions.text: What was the name of Rehoboam's mother?
questions.explanation: His mother's name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

questions.text: Why did Rehoboam do what was evil?
questions.explanation: He did that which was evil because he didn't set his heart to seek Yahweh.

answers.text: He didn't set his heart to seek Yahweh
He listened to the queen of Sheba
He was too young to rule

questions.text: Who reigned in Rehoboam's place after he died?
questions.explanation: Rehoboam was buried in David's city, and Abijah his son reigned in his place.
